about: Goes inside one of your or an ally's castles or towns and stays there.
calls_back: the holding is besieged, or it falls

stay_inside: 1: stays inside even when an enemy comes that the place would not hold against; 0: leaves then, and shelters where the defence would hold or falls back

when.poke: {at} is no longer friendly, so {me} did not garrison it.
{at} is besieged by {besieger(at)} (strength {siege_strength(at)}); {me} is inside with strength {strength}.
The siege of {at} is over; {me} is still inside.
